analysis.title: Why a Democrat-controlled Congress means higher US drug prices, for now
key_insights: ING's senior healthcare economist Diederik Stadig argues in a video note (6 Nov 2026) that Democrats winning both the House and Senate could have the unexpected consequence of higher US drug prices in the near term.
The PDF carries only the video teaser and disclaimer text. The reasoning, mechanism and any figures are in the video and are not in the extracted text.
contextual_mentions: Democrat-controlled House and Senate after the 2026 US elections
US drug pricing policy under a Democratic Congress
